_comment: Coding tool set for TASK-DEV-1 (Epic P12-M41-E41.2 D4). Same shape and same enabled list as this repository's .ai-project/agents/tools.json, so the measurement is comparable to the lane's real configuration. allow_paths is scoped to the instantiated workspace and NOT to any real repository: the measurement workspace is always instantiated into a directory named 'e412-dev-workspace', which is what makes an absolute-path glob possible without hardcoding a home directory. allow_commands is the repo set's pytest surface, unchanged.
